#+TITLE: Planets

Planets, in a table wider than the window.

| Key | Planet  | Summary                                                                 | Atmosphere                                                                      | Discovery                                                                                                                    |
|-----+---------+-------------------------------------------------------------------------+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
|     |         | <30>                                                                    | <30>                                                                            | <30>                                                                                                                         |
|   3 | Earth   | The third planet from the Sun, and the only one known to harbour life   | Nitrogen and oxygen, with traces of argon, carbon dioxide and water vapour      | Known since prehistory; first photographed whole from space by the crew of Apollo 17, on 7 December 1972, as the Blue Marble |
|   1 | Mercury | The smallest planet, and the closest to the Sun, with a large iron core | Almost none: a thin exosphere of oxygen, sodium, hydrogen, helium and potassium | Known since antiquity; first visited by the Mariner 10 probe in 1974 and 1975, then orbited by MESSENGER from 2011 to 2015   |
|   2 | Venus   | The hottest planet, wrapped in thick clouds of sulphuric acid           | Dense carbon dioxide, with a surface pressure about ninety times that of Earth  | Known since antiquity; Venera 7 made the first soft landing on it in 1970, and sent back data for twenty-three minutes       |

Prose after the table.
